newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama's stock exchange volume up 91.3 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Panama's stock exchange volume up 91.3 pct in 1996.

text.p: Trading volume on Panama's budding stock market jumped 91.3 percent in 1996 to close the year at $446.5 million, bolsa director Roberto Brenes said.
He said the increase, from $233.4 million in 1995, was mainly due to listed companies making larger volume listings of bond issues and short-term commercial paper.
Trading volume five years ago in 1991 totalled $30.6 million.
